item.title: Get to know the Cartoonist of the Year nominees!
item.description: Mark Tatulli In 1988, Mark Tatulli drew his first published newspaper comic strip for the Burlington County Times in New Jersey. His next strip, “Bent Halos,” a comic about a couple of rambunctious angels, was nationally syndicated. Tatulli eventually put the strip into hiatus to pursue other strip concepts with broader appeal. item.title: Mark Parisi wins Cartoonist of the Year
item.description: Three AMS creators took home awards at the 79th Annual Reuben Awards, but Mark Parisi (Off the Mark) was the big winner taking home Cartoonist of the Year. Other winners included Dave Blazek (Loose Parts) for Best Newspaper Panel and Reza Farazmand for Best Online Comic – Short Form. The post Mark Parisi wins Cartoonist of the Year appeared first on Andrews McMeel Universal.

item.title: Andrews McMeel Syndication Announces Caroline Cash as New Nancy Creator
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo — September 15, 2025 – Andrews McMeel Syndication (AMS) has announced renowned cartoonist Caroline Cash as the new cartoonist for the legendary Nancy comic strip. After nearly a decade of creating the strip, Olivia Jaimes has retired. The new Nancy strips will debut January 1, 2026. Nancy classics (by previous Nancy creator Ernie Bushmiller) will run until that date.
